info.title: TIMEFLOW API
info.description: Time intelligence engine. Authentication uses an HttpOnly session cookie; state-changing requests must send the CSRF token returned by POST /auth/login, POST /auth/register or GET /auth/session in the X-CSRF-Token header.

weekStartsOn.description: ISO weekday the week starts on (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday).

dayStartMinute.description: Default active hours (minutes from local midnight).

focusPeakStartMinute.description: Send null for both to clear the declared focus window.

timezone.description: Browser-detected IANA timezone; can be changed later in preferences.

csrfToken.description: Send back in the X-CSRF-Token header on every state-changing request. Keep in memory only.

current.description: True for the session making this request.

durationSec.description: Tracked seconds, computed by the server from persisted timestamps.

autoStopped.description: The stop time was reconstructed because the timer was left running.

version.description: Concurrency token: send it back as expectedVersion to detect stale tabs.

session.description: Null when no timer is running or paused.

serverTime.description: Server clock at the moment `elapsedSec` was computed.

elapsedSec.description:
Tracked seconds at `serverTime`. While the session is RUNNING the client adds its own
monotonic time since receiving this response — it never counts on its own.

expectedTotalSec.description: Planned/estimated total for the activity, when known.

activityId.description: Existing activity to track. Omit to quick-start a new ad-hoc activity with title + categoryId.

switchedFromSessionId.description: Set when starting this timer stopped a different running activity (activity switch).

expectedVersion.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency check; 409 TIMER_STATE_CHANGED if another tab acted first.
Optional optimistic-concurrency check; 409 TIMER_STATE_CHANGED if another tab acted first.

complete.description: Also mark the activity as completed.

totalDurationSec.description: Total tracked seconds across all sessions matching the filter (not just this page).

reason.description: Why the entry is being corrected. Stored in the audit trail.

plannedStart.description: Planned start (UTC instant). Null for ad-hoc activities that were only tracked.

plannedDurationSec.description: Planned length in seconds, derived from plannedStart/plannedEnd.

actualDurationSec.description: Seconds actually tracked. Scheduled time alone never counts as done.

taskId.description: Link this block to a task (a scheduled work block for it).

plannedStart.description: New planned start; the original length is kept. Omit to create an unscheduled copy.

factors.description: Why the confidence is not 100. Empty for fully confirmed availability.

StripState.description:
Past: TRACKED (measured), PLANNED_UNTRACKED (planned, no tracking), UNKNOWN (no data — not free).
Future: BUSY, BUFFER, BLOCKED, FREE (offered), FRAGMENT (free but below minimum slot).
OUTSIDE_HOURS: outside the user's active hours.

state.description:
Past: TRACKED (measured), PLANNED_UNTRACKED (planned, no tracking), UNKNOWN (no data — not free).
Future: BUSY, BUFFER, BLOCKED, FREE (offered), FRAGMENT (free but below minimum slot).
OUTSIDE_HOURS: outside the user's active hours.

id.description: Activity id, or `${scheduleEventId}:${date}` for a recurring occurrence.

actualDurationSec.description: Seconds tracked on this block's activity (0 for recurring occurrences).

freeSec.description: Bookable future time in offered windows.

plannedUntrackedSec.description: Past planned time without tracking — unverified.

unknownSec.description: Past active-hours time with no plan and no tracking. Unknown, NOT free.

range.description: Instant range of the local day (23–25h long around DST changes).

windowStart.description: The free window the slot was taken from.

dependsOn.description: Tasks that must be completed first.

isBlocked.description: True while any dependency is not completed.

scheduledBlocks.description: Work blocks scheduled on the calendar for this task.

trackedSec.description: Seconds tracked across all of its work blocks.

byWeekday.description: ISO weekdays (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday) for weekly rules.

startDate.description: First local date of the series. Defaults to today.

status.description: Use the complete / reopen endpoints to move to or from COMPLETED.

end.description: Defaults to start + the task's estimated duration.

EnergySource.description: LOGGED: recent check-in. FORECAST: from your history. DECLARED: from your preferences. UNKNOWN: no basis.

source.description: LOGGED: recent check-in. FORECAST: from your history. DECLARED: from your preferences. UNKNOWN: no basis.

energy.description: 1..5, or null when there is no basis for an expectation.

sampleSize.description: Check-ins the forecast is built from (last 60 days).

nextOccurrences.description: Next local dates on which it occurs (up to 5).

startMinute.description: Local start time, minutes from midnight (0..1439).

date.description: Local date to plan. Defaults to today.

taskIds.description: Restrict the plan to these tasks. Default: every actionable, unscheduled task.

blocks.description: A proposal only — nothing is saved until it is applied.

freeSec.description: Free time on the day before the proposal.

energyUnknown.description: True when placement could not use any energy data.

energyConfidence.description: 0..100 confidence of the energy forecast used.

energy.description: Override the current energy level for this request.

availableMinutes.description: "I have N minutes": only tasks that fit are considered.

date.description: Local date to recommend for. Defaults to today.

factor.description: urgency | priority | fit | energy | focus | timeOfDay | history | momentum | leverage

points.description: Points this factor contributed to the 0..100 score.

confidence.description: 0..100 — how well the inputs support this recommendation (not how good the task is).

reasons.description: Human-readable reasons, strongest first. Generated from the same numbers as the score.

estimatedDurationSec.description: Estimate adjusted by the user's own history.

excluded.description: Open tasks that were considered but not recommended, with the reason.

userState.description: The user state the scoring used.

usedDeclaredTime.description: Set when the user-declared time was used because the calendar showed no free window now.

emptyReason.description: Why there is nothing to recommend, when `recommendation` is null.

activity.description: The work block created on the calendar.

weight.description: Effective weight after re-normalising over the components that could be measured.

availableSec.description: Bookable free time left today (from the availability engine).

isEmptyAccount.description: True until the user has created any activity or task — drives onboarding empty states.

windows.description: Free windows left today, soonest first.

adherencePct.description: Null = not measurable for this day (e.g. nothing was planned).

productivityScore.description: 0..100, or null when nothing was tracked (no data is not a score of zero).

focusSec.description: Productive time in uninterrupted segments of 25+ minutes.

leakageSec.description: Short unplanned gaps between tracked blocks.

unknownSec.description: Past active-hours time with no plan and no tracking — unknown, not free and not wasted.

taskCompletionRatePct.description: Completed ÷ (completed + still-open tasks that were due) in the period. Null when nothing was due or done.

avgSessionSec.description: Mean length of stopped tracking sessions in the period.

activeDays.description: Days in the period with any tracked time.

avgTrackedSec.description: Average tracked seconds in this weekday-hour across the period.

changePct.description: Null when the previous value is zero (no meaningful percentage).

isComplete.description: False while the period is still running.

highlights.description: Plain-language statements derived from the numbers above.

restSec.description: Tracked rest. Rest is never treated as wasted time.

plannedDowntimeSec.description: Time deliberately planned for rest or leisure.

unplannedGapSec.description: The only bucket counted as leakage.

impactSec.description: Measured seconds affected; null when the pattern has no directly measurable cost.

statement.description: Probabilistic wording. When data is insufficient this says so instead of guessing.

provider.description: Engine that produced the report (statistical baseline today; pluggable).

notice.description: Shown to the user whenever mode is "demo".

tools.description: Tools the coach may call. All are read-only except proposals, which need confirmation.

conversationId.description: Continue an existing conversation; omit to start a new one.

input.description: Arguments the model supplied (validated server-side before use).

provider.description: "anthropic" for a real model, "demo" for the deterministic demo engine.

isDemo.description: True when the answer was produced by the demo engine, not a language model.

summary.description: Plain-language description of the change that will be made if confirmed.

costMicroUsd.description: Estimated cost in millionths of a US dollar (0 in demo mode).

pendingActions.description: Schedule changes the coach proposed. Nothing changes until the user confirms.

result.description: Result of applying it, e.g. the created activity id.
